name: Blue Imogen

intro.text: The Boat Race: Oxford versus Cambridge on the Thames, every year since 1856, give or take a war. I've trained for it at five every morning. I'm awake now, so: battle.

after: The Cam's too narrow for proper racing, so the colleges hold the Bumps: you chase the boat ahead and try to bump it. It is exactly as chaotic as it sounds.
